preset.why: Measured baseline for clear 1080p60 playback using the VP9 decoder.

buffer.label: medium
buffer.why: Medium buffer balances startup time and recovery from short network dips.

afr.why: Automatic frame-rate switching is enabled for smoother matching playback.

network_engine.name: Cronet
network_engine.why: Measured stable network engine on this Chromecast baseline.

hardware_decoder.why: Software decoder was measured as the reliable baseline on armeabi-v7a.

prefer_avc.why: AVC preference is off so the measured VP9 preset remains eligible.
